Mixture of Experts · Review11

Parameter and Compute Distribution in LLMs

The majority of our parameters and compute in an LLM are actually in the FFN (MLP), not the attention block.

To reduce this, we can use a technique called Mixture of Experts for the FFN.

Mixture of Experts · Mixture of Experts12

Mixture of Experts

Mixture of Experts splits our neural network into smaller pieces called "Experts" of which we only activate a few at a time for each token.

Our collection of experts has the same total parameter capacity, but fewer "active" params that we need to use during inference.

The number of experts is something we pick, similar to the number of attention heads.

Mixture of Experts · Mixture of Experts13

Mixture of Experts

We use ωR to create "routing scores" for our experts based on the attention output for the token.

If we were asking an LLM a question about football, we could only activate the football expert. This is just the intuition.

Mixture of Experts · Mixture of Experts14

Inside an Expert

Each expert is just a smaller FFN but the architecture is identical to the original large one. This is just the intuition.

Mixture of Experts · Mixture of Experts15

Issues with Routing to our Experts

Experts 2 and 5 are overloaded, experts 1, 6 and 8 get nothing. The balance loss pushes the bars toward the dashed line.

Optional capacity limit: tokens beyond an expert's cap are dropped or sent to their next choice.
